vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect feature contains a command injection vulnerability that enables an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or apply updates per vendor instructions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 (excluding security releases 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1) JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Kernel Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability in the kernel that may allow an app to modify sensitive kernel state.
The SSH transport protocol with ChaCha20-Poly1305 or Encrypt-then-MAC allows prefix truncation attacks.
